title: The Loan Fee Anomaly: A Short Seller's Best Ideas
one_line: Equity loan fees are the best single predictor of cross-sectional returns among 103 anomalies: highest long-short return (1.17%/month) and Sharpe (0.40/month), persistent through the sample; ~72% of it reflects short sellers' unique information.

findings.statement: Long-short 1.17%/month, monthly Sharpe 0.40 — top of 103 anomalies.
~28% explained by exposure to other strong anomalies; ~72% unique.

why.pattern: Informed short sellers paying to borrow.

reported_results.headline: Equity loan fees are the best single predictor of cross-sectional returns among 103 anomalies: highest long-short return (1.17%/month) and Sharpe (0.40/month), persistent through the sample; ~72% of it reflects short sellers' unique information.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 4), not by the weekly pipeline.
